discovery_seed.accuracy: HABS catalogue coordinate; cluster search seed only

runtime_seed.derivation: HABS catalogue coordinate transformed into the terrain world frame

current_extract.policy: Do not bind to an unnamed footprint by nearest-centroid distance alone.

resolution_steps: Georeference the HABS measured site plan and National Register site map against Mormon Row Road, Ditch Creek, the east-west service road and surviving fence lines.
Intersect the registered plan with building-class LiDAR and current orthophotography to identify the cabin and evolved stable/barn footprints.
Resolve the windmill against the registered map and visible tower base; do not inherit a transform from the adjacent Roy Chambers complex.
Store every structure transform relative to a single surveyed cluster anchor in EPSG:32612.
Suppress a generic runtime building only after its footprint overlap and orientation pass the placement gates.

lod.policy: Export one cluster LOD per distance tier, keep per-structure transforms inspectable, and display exactly one tier at a time.

constraints: Render a fixed orthographic clay target from approved geometry before any image-assisted edit.
Use only same-structure HABS or NPS references; never mix the cabin, barn, adjacent homesteads or Moulton buildings.
Preserve target silhouette, pixel registration, roof topology, openings and background exactly.
Do not infer dimensions, placement, roof topology or structural members from generated imagery.
Do not add baked landscape, directional sunlight, text, watermarks, extra windows or featureless black openings.
Regenerate every projection after any geometry or camera change.

quarantine_gates.rule: Each projected structure needs an official HABS/NPS source plus two useful same-structure elevations with reviewable rights.
The windmill is excluded from exports until the registered site map proves that its tower belongs in this cluster rather than the adjacent Roy Chambers complex.
All three transforms must satisfy the documented control-point, footprint, orientation and residual limits.
The cabin must retain both full-length shed porches; the barn must retain its gambrel core and single west shed; the windmill must remain open lattice geometry.
Reject silhouette drift, cross-building contamination, pure-black placeholder openings and baked scenery.
Reject floating foundations, buried doors, broad vegetation clearing and lost fence or ditch context.
Reject any tier or texture set above the declared cluster budgets.
